integrity: The proof gives exact algebraic arguments for every prime power and nonzero twist. Seven exhaustive finite-field block enumerations were run from the included standard-library checker; neither independent mathematical audit nor historical novelty certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts labelled pairs only in even dimension with maximal square-zero first rank; does not classify other first-rank strata, odd dimensions, conjugacy orbits, other nilpotency bounds or nonreduced schemes. Known aggregate nilpotent-pair invariance is prior art. Independent verification and exhaustive priority certification are not performed.
title: Rank-stratified square-zero representations of two-generator quantum complete intersections
